title: Low-Cal Carrot and Cannellini Soup
subtitle: with Crunchy Pepitas
description: With nutrient-rich carrots, iron-packed spinach and cannellini beans for fibre and protein, this golden soup is loaded with goodness. Finished with a toasted wholemeal roll for dipping, it's simply delicious!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Halve the leek lengthwise and thinly slice the pale stem (see Kitchen 101). Peel the carrots, then cut into 1cm chunks. Coarsely chop the spinach. Crush or finely chop 1 garlic clove and halve the remaining clove. Drain and rinse the beans.

Start soup: Crumble the stock cubes into a large heatproof jug, add 750ml (3 cups) boiling water and stir to dissolve. Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Cook the leek, stirring, for 3-4 mins until softened. Add the carrot and chopped garlic, season with salt and pepper and cook, stirring, for 2 mins or until fragrant.

Simmer soup: Add the stock to the pan and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, covered, for 25 mins or until the carrot is tender. Add the beans to the soup and cook for 1-2 mins until warmed through. Remove the pan from the heat.

Make garlic bread: Meanwhile, put the pepitas in a cold medium frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 2-3 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan. Cut the wholemeal rolls in half and rub the cut side of each roll with the cut sides of the garlic clove. Return the pan to high heat, then cook the garlic bread, cut side down, for 1-2 mins until toasted and warmed through.

Serve up: Blend the soup with a stick blender until smooth, then stir in the spinach to wilt. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the soup among bowls, scatter over the pepitas and serve with the garlic bread. Enjoy!
Kitchen 101: Prior to chopping, give the pale part of the leek a good rinse under running water to remove any hidden dirt.
